name: Appsmith 2.7 Community
description: Low-code internal tools builder, admin pre-created, sign-up closed

upstream.appsmith: appsmith/appsmith-ce:v2.7.2@sha256:1f456089b75edec495c005f0e94858aa5c6d1408fcac5f7c1e2d85d69bd1592d (Appsmith CE v2.7.2, 2026-11-19; embedded MongoDB, Redis and Caddy)

PORT.description: Private healthcheck port (200 only after the administrator exists). The public domain targets Appsmith on 80.

APPSMITH_HTTP_PORT.description: Port of Appsmith's web server inside the container (the public domain targets it).

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Login e-mail of the first administrator, created on the first boot.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password of the first administrator (8-48 characters). Used on the first boot, or with ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESET=true.

ADMIN_NAME.description: Display name of the first administrator.

ADMIN_PASSWORD_RESET.description: true = set the password of ADMIN_EMAIL to ADMIN_PASSWORD on the next boot (recovery). Set back to false afterwards.

APPSMITH_ADMIN_EMAILS.description: Comma-separated e-mails with access to Admin Settings.

APPSMITH_SIGNUP_DISABLED.description: true = only invited users can join (invite them from a workspace). false opens sign-up to anyone who can reach the URL.

APPSMITH_DISABLE_TELEMETRY.description: Do not send anonymous usage data to Appsmith.

APPSMITH_BASE_URL.description: Public URL used in links and e-mails. Change it when you add a custom domain.

APPSMITH_JAVA_HEAP_ARG.description: Java heap of the Appsmith backend. Raise (e.g. -Xmx2048m) for many users or large apps.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds Appsmith gets to stop its embedded MongoDB cleanly on redeploy.
